_about: Travelovegas listings inventory, rebuilt from the old Wix site screenshots and re-checked Oct 8, 2026. status: open = recent evidence it's operating; likely_open = evergreen, no closure news found, confirm on the affiliate page before linking; changed = still exists but key facts moved; seasonal = open part of the year; temp_closed; closed = remove. Old prices and hours from the Wix site are NOT carried over; every price/hours field starts null until verified.

listings.name: Fountains of Bellagio
listings.notes: Patriotic fountain show ran June 29 to July 4, 2026. Sidewalk in front of the fountains closed Sept 14 to Nov 9, 2026 for F1 Fountain Club construction; viewing is limited during F1 build-out. Show times only from third-party guides, not listed.

listings.name: Bellagio Conservatory & Botanical Gardens
listings.notes: New autumn display unveiled Sept 23, 2026 (described as a "nostalgic autumn escape"); official display name and end date not stated. Free to visit.

listings.name: Eiffel Tower Viewing Deck
listings.notes: Deck tickets were part of the Las Vegas 5-Day Sale (Sept 22, 2026). Official page live. Old 'from $27.01' price dropped; re-price from affiliate.

listings.name: The STRAT SkyPod & Thrill Rides
listings.notes: OLD COPY WAS WRONG: described a fire-and-water show near the Mirage, not the STRAT. Rewrite from scratch. Official attractions page lists SkyPod, thrill rides (incl. Big Shot) and SkyJump; X-Scream and Insanity not named there, so do not mention them.

listings.name: SkyJump
listings.notes: Listed by multiple 2026 sellers.

listings.name: SlotZilla Zipline
listings.price: Zip Line from $49 (Mon-Thu), $55 (Fri-Sun); Zoom Line from $69 (Mon-Thu), $75 (Fri-Sun)
listings.notes: Prices and hours from the official Fremont Street Experience page.

listings.name: Fremont Street Experience
listings.notes: Official site: "Open 24 Hours", free live concerts. Viva Vision show times not on the page; don't list them.

listings.name: Welcome to Fabulous Las Vegas Sign
listings.notes: Clark County lights the sign for causes; most recent: Indigenous Peoples' Day colors Oct 12, 2026. Old "24/7" hours kept but no source states them.

listings.name: High Roller
listings.notes: Feb 2026: wheel stopped ~90 min after a network issue; resumed same night. Ride is about 30 minutes (LV Magazine, Mar 2026).

listings.name: FLY LINQ Zipline
listings.notes: unconfirmed. Old hours read '2PM to 10AM' (typo). Only third-party 2026 seller listings found; official site would not load.

listings.name: The Big Apple Coaster
listings.notes: unconfirmed. LVA lists hours and $15-17 pricing but the page is undated; confirm before showing. No 2026 news or reachable official page (MGM sites block fetching).

listings.name: Sphere
listings.notes: Venue entry. Current shows listed separately: wizard-of-oz-sphere and metallica-sphere. The exterior is a free viewing spot.

listings.name: Gondola Rides
listings.hours: Indoor: Sun-Thu 10am-11pm, Fri-Sat 10am-midnight. Outdoor: daily 10am-11pm, seasonal and weather permitting
listings.notes: Official page; also lists $34 select-date pricing Sept to Dec and a $156 private gondola. Same-day tickets sold in person only.

listings.name: LOVE Sculpture
listings.notes: unconfirmed. Removed Aug 2025 for a Wizard of Oz at Sphere display; Venetian said it would return but gave no date. No report of reinstallation found as of Oct 2026. Do not list.

listings.name: FlyOver Las Vegas
listings.notes: unconfirmed. Official site redirects to experienceflyover.com/lasvegas but content would not load; no 2026 news found. Nathan Burton's show runs inside the FlyOver building (Go City).

listings.name: Marvel Avengers S.T.A.T.I.O.N.
listings.notes: Closed Jan 1, 2024. Remove.

listings.name: Real Bodies
listings.notes: Old copy said Bally's; the property is now Horseshoe. Still sold by 2026 ticket sellers. Drop the old COVID-19 section copy.

listings.name: The Escape Game
listings.notes: Official location page: 3500 Las Vegas Blvd S, Ste M-9 (Forum Shops). Second Vegas location at AREA15. Prices not listed.

listings.name: Shark Reef Aquarium
listings.notes: "Yoga with Sharks" class series inside the aquarium reported Sept 2026. Old copy's 'largest aquarium in North America' claim is unverified; drop it.

listings.name: Encore Beach Club
listings.notes: Events listed through October 2026; dayclubs typically go quiet over winter. Show a season banner.

listings.name: Wet Republic
listings.notes: Final season was 2024. Space reopened as Palm Tree Beach Club (Tao Group x Kygo). Remove; consider adding Palm Tree Beach Club after verifying.

listings.name: XS Nightclub
listings.notes: Closed summer 2026 for renovation. Grand reopening Thursday Nov 5, 2026 (RUFUS DU SOL), four-night celebration through Nov 8 per Wynn press release Aug 18, 2026.

listings.name: America's Got Talent Presents Superstars Live
listings.notes: Closed May 11, 2024. Remove.

listings.name: Nathan Burton Comedy Magic
listings.venue: FlyOver building, 3771 S Las Vegas Blvd (next to Hard Rock Cafe)
listings.notes: Venue and daily 4pm show from Go City (Oct 2026). 70-minute family show. Confirm time on affiliate page before showing.

listings.name: Criss Angel MINDFREAK
listings.notes: unconfirmed. Only 2026 evidence is reseller listings (July-Aug 2026) and the Alice Cooper + Criss Angel "Welcome to Our Nightmare" dates at the Criss Angel Theater (Mar-May 2026). Check the current schedule on the affiliate page before linking.

listings.name: O by Cirque du Soleil
listings.notes: 90 minutes, no intermission. Minimum age 5. 2027 tickets on sale (Sept 2026). Official listing showed "from $125" in search data only; price left null until confirmed on affiliate.

listings.name: Las Vegas Strip Night Bus Tour
listings.notes: unconfirmed. Old site didn't name the operator; old $44/$55 prices dropped. Pick a current operator from the affiliate catalog.

listings.name: Bright Lights Vegas Night Tour (Jeep)
listings.notes: unconfirmed. Old copy mentions the Mirage volcano; the Mirage closed in July 2024. Rewrite.

listings.name: David Copperfield
listings.notes: Residency ended Apr 30, 2026. Remove.

listings.name: Le Cirque
listings.notes: Closed after dinner Aug 23, 2026. New concept planned for the space in mid-2027.

listings.name: Picasso
listings.notes: Closed Aug 2024.

listings.name: Aureole
listings.notes: Closed 2024.

listings.name: Margaritaville
listings.notes: Closed Apr 15, 2024.

listings.name: Diablo's Cantina
listings.notes: Closed (per project brief). The Mirage closed July 2024.

listings.name: Red Lotus
listings.notes: Closed. Tropicana closed Apr 2, 2024.

listings.name: Robert Irvine's Public House
listings.notes: Closed with the Tropicana, Apr 2, 2024. Not reopened elsewhere as of 2026.

listings.name: KÀ by Cirque du Soleil
listings.notes: 90 minutes. No children under 3; under 18 must be with an adult. 2027 schedule changes (Mon, Tue, Fri 6pm and 8:30pm; Sat-Sun 4:30pm and 7pm; dark Wed-Thu).

listings.name: Mystère by Cirque du Soleil
listings.notes: 90 minutes. Suitable for all ages; under 1 free on a lap. Child pricing available. 2027 schedule reported as Tue-Sat 6:30pm and 9pm; confirm.

listings.name: Michael Jackson ONE by Cirque du Soleil
listings.notes: 90 minutes, no intermission. No children under 5; under 16 must be with an adult. 2027 tickets on sale (Sept 2026).

listings.name: Mad Apple by Cirque du Soleil
listings.notes: Final show Sept 5, 2026. Not in the 2027 on-sale list. Remove.

listings.name: Blue Man Group
listings.notes: 90 to 105 minutes, no intermission. Recommended 3+; 4 and up need a ticket; under 18 with an adult. Sensory-friendly show held June 2026.

listings.name: Absinthe
listings.venue: Spiegeltent, Roman Plaza at Caesars Palace
listings.notes: Celebrated 15 years in April 2026. DARK Nov 16-29, 2026 for tent upgrades (F1 week); show a banner for those dates. Raunchy comedy; confirm age policy on affiliate page before showing one.

listings.name: Shin Lim: Limitless
listings.venue: The Palazzo Theatre at The Venetian
listings.notes: Official page: tickets on sale now, for audiences 4+. Listed under the Venetian's 2026 residency shows. Schedule and price not on the official page.

listings.name: Mat Franco: Magic Reinvented Nightly
listings.venue: Mat Franco Theater at The LINQ
listings.notes: Signed a 5-year extension in Mar 2026 to stay at The LINQ through 2030. 3,000th show June 2026. Schedule and price not on an official page.

listings.name: The Wizard of Oz at Sphere
listings.notes: Multiple showtimes daily; tickets on sale through early 2027. New 4D effects (winged monkeys, scents, fireworks) since Sept 25, 2026. About 75 minutes. Ages 6+, every guest needs a ticket.

listings.name: Metallica: Life Burns Faster
listings.notes: Limited residency. 2026 dates: Oct 1, 3, 8, 10, 15, 17, 22, 24, 29, 31; Nov 5, 7. 2027: Jan 28, 30; Feb 4, 6, 18, 20, 25, 27; Mar 4, 6, 11, 13. Different setlist Thu vs Sat. Sold via Ticketmaster, reported sold out; no affiliate link. Mark closed after Mar 13, 2027.

listings.name: Grand Canyon West & Skywalk
listings.hours: Daily 8am-6pm Arizona time, last entry 4:30pm (summer: last entry 5:30pm, close 7pm)
listings.notes: Official site. Open every day including holidays. Sunset Pass gives entry after 3pm. Most visitors go on a bus or air day tour from Vegas; pick operator from affiliate catalog.

listings.name: Grand Canyon Helicopter Tour with Canyon Floor Landing (Maverick)
listings.venue: Maverick Helicopters, 6075 S Las Vegas Blvd
listings.notes: Official site lists Wind Dancer (from $599), Wind Dancer Sunset (from $629), Skywalk Odyssey (from $639). First Grand Canyon flight 7am. Weather or wind can cancel flights. Closed-toe shoes recommended.

listings.name: Grand Celebration Helicopter Tour (Papillon)
listings.notes: Official site: Grand Canyon West with canyon floor landing, about 4 to 4.5 hours hotel to hotel. Also Golden Eagle Air Tour (about 3.5 to 4 hours). Prices not on the overview page. Most tours run 364 days a year.

listings.name: Las Vegas Strip Helicopter Night Flight
listings.venue: Maverick Helicopters, 6075 S Las Vegas Blvd
listings.notes: Papillon also runs a Strip Highlights night flight (about 10 to 15 minutes). Weather can cancel flights.

listings.name: Hoover Dam Tours
listings.price: Guided Dam Tour $40; Power Plant Tour $25 adults, $15 ages 4-16; Visitor Center self-guided $15; 3 and under free
listings.hours: Visitor Center and tours daily 9am-5pm, last tour 4:10pm; closed Thanksgiving and Christmas
listings.notes: Official Bureau of Reclamation page (updated July 29, 2026). Guided Dam Tour tickets sold on site only, first come first served. Interagency passes not accepted. Tours may be cancelled without notice.

listings.name: Red Rock Canyon Scenic Drive
listings.venue: Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area
listings.hours: Scenic Drive 6am-7pm in October; 6am-5pm Nov-Feb; 6am-7pm March; 6am-8pm Apr-Sept
listings.notes: Timed-entry reservation required Oct 1 to May 31 for entry 8am-5pm (Recreation.gov). Entry fee amount not stated on BLM page; leave null. Red Rock Overlook is free with no reservation. Commercial tour buses limited to 4 stops, no hiking.

listings.name: Valley of Fire State Park
listings.venue: Overton, NV (about 1 hour from the Strip)
listings.notes: Closed to all visitors Dec 1-14 every year for maintenance. Many trails (White Domes, Pinnacles, Charlie's Spring) close May 15 to Sept 30 for heat. Official page mentions a temporary West Entrance closure with no dates; check before listing directions.

listings.name: Grand Canyon South Rim Day Tour
listings.notes: NPS conditions page (updated Sept 1, 2026). Long day trip from Vegas (South Rim is far; pick an operator on the affiliate). Entrance fee not stated on the page.

listings.name: Zion National Park Day Tour
listings.notes: NPS page (updated Sept 16, 2026). East Rim Trail partly closed after rockfall; Hidden Canyon closed; Observation Point only from the east. Free shuttles run early spring to late fall.

listings.name: Death Valley Day Tour
listings.notes: NPS page (updated Oct 2, 2026). Scotty's Castle and Bonnie Clare Road closed, no reopening date. Titus Canyon one-way section closed until about May 2027; two-way section closed Oct 27 through December 2026. Darwin Falls road closed until about summer 2027.

listings.name: The Neon Museum
listings.notes: Official site. 45-minute guided add-ons: History Tour, Movies Tour, Spanish-language tour, Brilliant! Jackpot show. Ticketing simplifies to one 2027 Admission from Jan 1, 2027.

listings.name: Lake of Dreams
listings.hours: Nightly every half hour from dusk until 11:30pm
listings.notes: Official Wynn page: free to the public. Faces inward, not the Strip. Free viewing at the North Show Terrace, Bar Parasol and Overlook Lounge.

listings.name: Ethel M Chocolates Factory & Botanical Cactus Garden
listings.notes: Official page: garden and self-guided factory tour are free. Holiday lights start early November each year; 2026 dates and any fee not yet posted, leave out until confirmed.

listings.name: Downtown Container Park
listings.hours: Restaurants and bars Mon-Thu 11:30am-11pm, Fri-Sat 11am-1am, Sun 11am-8pm. Retail Mon-Thu 11:30am-8pm, Fri-Sat 11am-9pm, Sun 11am-8pm
listings.notes: Official site: no entrance fee (some special events may charge). Kids allowed until 9pm, 21+ after 9pm. The Mantis fire show and drum circle Wed-Sun from sunset. Events listed for Oct 2026.

listings.name: Seven Magic Mountains
listings.venue: I-15 south of Las Vegas (Jean, NV area)
listings.notes: Stays in place until its BLM land lease ends in December 2026 (airport expansion); next location not announced. Show a banner. Admission and hours not stated by the sources, so free is false until confirmed (set true with a source).

listings.name: Flamingo Wildlife Habitat
listings.notes: unconfirmed. Official page title says "Free Garden" but showed no hours or details; no 2026 news. 2026 reviews say few birds visible. Hours conflict across third-party guides; leave null.

listings.name: Free Circus Acts at Circus Circus
listings.notes: unconfirmed. Only third-party guides; a July 2026 guide says acts now run Fri-Mon only, older pages say daily. Official page not reachable. free kept false until an official source says so.

listings.name: The Mirage Volcano
listings.venue: The Mirage (now being rebuilt as Hard Rock)
listings.notes: The Mirage closed July 2024. Never reference the volcano in copy. Remove.

not_yet_inventoried: restaurants (Italian, Asian, American, French, Indian, Mexican)

Drai's moved from the rooftop back to the basement space at The Vanderpump Hotel; rooftop is now a pool. Source: https://www.yahoo.com/news/articles/las-vegas-strip-nightclub-returns-022951826.html
Bally's is now Horseshoe Las Vegas: never say "Bally's" in copy
The Mirage and Tropicana are closed: drop any copy that references them (volcano, etc.)
Wet Republic (MGM Grand) closed after 2024; space is now Palm Tree Beach Club
Absinthe goes dark Nov 16-29, 2026 for Spiegeltent upgrades
XS reopens Nov 5, 2026: flip status to open after that date
Seven Magic Mountains BLM lease ends Dec 2026: re-check in January 2027 and flip to closed or new location
